question: What kind of teacher is fit to perform the highest initiatory rites?
premises: The revered Bhairava Kula states a standard for the teacher.
A fit teacher is one suited to the rite of the five initiations.
Such a teacher has either transcended the lower streams or is grounded in the Trika scripture.
inference: Only a teacher established beyond the lower streams or in the Trika is qualified for the highest initiatory rites.
plain_english: It is said in the revered Bhairava Kula that the teacher fit for the rite of the five initiations is one who has transcended the lower streams or who is grounded in the Trika scripture.
